## New vault format

Version 0.10.0 replaces the vault's database engine. It cannot open a vault from 0.9.x by itself, so your data moves to a new vault the first time you open this version.

### Updating from 0.9.2 inside the app

1. Open this version. It shows **Move your vault to the new format**.
2. Enter your usual master password and click **Move data**.

Your accounts, saved passwords, tags, favorite places, and settings move to a new vault with the same master password. The old vault moves to the recovery folder in `storage/vault` and is not deleted.

> [!WARNING]
> If you are on 0.9.1 or earlier, or you replaced the app by hand, this version shows **Vault from an older version** instead. Do not set the old vault aside unless you have an export file. Instead:
>
> 1. Download [version 0.9.2](https://github.com/sleaze5/RobloxAccountManager/releases/tag/v0.9.2) and replace this app with it.
> 2. Open 0.9.2, unlock the vault, and open **Settings > About**.
> 3. Click **Download update**, then **Restart to update**. 0.9.2 only offers 0.10.0, and saves your data before it restarts.
> 4. Follow the steps above.
>
> If you already have an export file, you can instead click **Set aside old vault**, create a new vault, then open **Add account > Import export file** and select your file.

After this update, updates work as usual again.
